project: ODSP individual vertical organization in an environmentally variable flight state-space

supported: BATTER bat per-individual vertical profile repeatability is heterogeneous across bat panels.
DELTATRACK gull has individual-ID altitude shape signal but tag/day and low-speed controls complicate mechanisms.
Zeebrugge Larus fuscus GPS profile transfer gains improve under site-scale CERRA wind regimes in 2016 and 2017, one species/network.
Two separately tagged Ciconia ciconia cohorts differed at identical newly established 50km identity endpoint: 2013 positive, 2014 not supported.
Finer horizontal route fidelity in both stork cohorts is stronger than the equal-bird other reference but not sufficient to guarantee repeatable vertical profile shape.
motivation.untested_primary_hypothesis: Across independent flight species and studies, within-day vertical probability-profile identity will transfer across days mainly where individuals encounter recurrent atmospheric/behavioral contexts, even after fine horizontal route and age/study structure are accounted for.
motivation.caution: Individuality != adaptation and atmospheric covariates != causal thermal lift experienced.

independent_source.source_paper: Airflows redefine the cost of aerial transport in the wild (Scacco et al.)
independent_source.source_flight_definition: Only commuting flight segments preclassified by the data producers; segment extraction itself must not be represented as entire free-ranging space use
independent_source.related_existing_analysis: Source authors' S10 repeatability analysis tested proportion flapping and effective transport cost, NOT the same GPS altitude probability-shape held-out estimand. Avoid presenting reanalysis of transport cost as novel.

source_independence_rules.unit: Study × species × tagged biological individual, with biologically independent UTC days as within-animal replication.
source_independence_rules.duplicates: Preserve original Movebank study.id and tag.local.identifier, study names, exact individual ID, timestamp and segment ID. Never count re-exports (including BATTER/ODSP candidate Movebank sources) as independent study replications; blacklist duplicate parent study and duplicate tag/time pairs against prior sources before outcome test.
source_independence_rules.source_legal: Check Zenodo record metadata for published license, rights and download restrictions; source authors encourage contacting each data owner for biological context, even for technically accessible archive.
source_independence_rules.specimen_handling: No personal human data are used; GPS location is animal-borne metadata. Respect dataset attribution and source usage terms.

use: Verify immutable archive file keys, byte size, checksums, publication date and license directly from Zenodo official API. Do not infer from file title.
Inspect ZIP central directory and RDS column names/types without computing altitude summaries or altitude missingness.
Count data quality for individual ID, study ID, species, UTC dates, GPS lon/lat, flight segment and ERA5 wind / thermal uplift, flapping probability or VeDBA.
Summarize # animals with >=2 different UTC dates and >=2 independent flight segments/date, and horizontal 5/50km shared support ONLY from x/y and time.
phase_1_preoutcome_catalog.no_rescue: A species-study or spatial resolution failing its fixed candidate gate is structurally unavailable, not a biological non-specialist or a negative outcome.

phase_2_conditional_vertical_model_if_pa.native_height: Source harmonized height_gener has both height-above-ellipsoid and height-above-MSL origin across studies. Never directly pool absolute elevation across source devices or baselines. Store per-row native height provenance; use within-bird-day center in shape profiles, audit tag heteroscedastic errors.
phase_2_conditional_vertical_model_if_pa.primary_predictor: Source's ERA5 point-wise thermal uplift potential (Wstar), if field is genuinely available, plus independently classified flapping/soaring probability; windSpeed_1000m and Orographic_uplift_potential as planned independent covariates, not outcome-selected.
hierarchical_references: Population/study-specific contextual model P(z_center | 5km cell, ERA5 thermal/wind regime, movement class, season)
Within-individual contextual model P(z_center | identity, same cell, same environment, class, season)
Individual-specific wind/thermal reaction norm; incremental held-out gain beyond common species-wide environmental response
phase_2_conditional_vertical_model_if_pa.split: Whole bird days held out with donor days of same source, and independent entire study/species holdouts for meta generality. Never split fixes from same day/segment across training and test.
phase_2_conditional_vertical_model_if_pa.null: Whole-session within source and matched month/age/movement-context permutations; quantify effect null-relative without comparing raw nats across mismatched geometry or predictor families.
phase_2_conditional_vertical_model_if_pa.hierarchical_meta: Estimate proportion of eligible study-species cells with positive study-scale effect using study-cluster resampling; don't count individual GPS fixes as replicates, and don't claim universal biological effect from a selected subset.

limitations: 38 species and 853 individuals are SOURCE UNIVERSE, not 38 admitted independent biological results.
Source paper already reported flapping probability and effective COT; this program tests conditional vertical distribution shape, different endpoint.
GPS-derived environment annotations and preselected commuting flights may be correlated with altitude and selective availability, requiring source instrument/site auditing.
Age/breeding central-place vs migration ecological status must be source-specific, not guessed from species alone.
Observational horizontal/vertical co-use and regional wind associations do not identify adaptation, niche partitioning, genetic temperament, or causal flight control.
next_stage: Archive API + ZIP metadata, then outcome-blind study/species/day/source-support ledger; only open native GPS altitude outcomes after freezing all admissible panels.
